name: Baptism Of Babies
overview: The Scriptures affirm the value and innocence of children, as Jesus welcomed little children and emphasized that the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these (Matthew 19:14; Mark 10:13). Baptism is commanded for all nations as a sign of discipleship and salvation, but it is linked explicitly to personal belief (Matthew 28:19; Mark 16:16). The reality of sin from conception is acknowledged (Psalms 51:5), yet the New Testament teachings highlight the necessity of faith preceding baptism, underscoring that baptism itself is not a means of salvation apart from belief.
